facts.text: Toyota SEnS+ is dated August 2021 in the forklift and warehouse vehicle precedents.
Toyota SEnS+ uses a rear stereo camera to distinguish people from objects.
facts.quote: A rear stereo camera distinguishes people from objects

facts.text: Toyota SEnS+ provides three warning levels, speed control and prevention of reverse start.
facts.quote: with three warning levels, speed control and prevention of reverse start.

facts.text: Toyota states that SEnS+ does not use the brake to decelerate and automatically stop; Toyota SEnS+ instead gradually decelerates by shutting off power.
facts.quote: does not have function in using the brake to decelerate and automatically stop, but gradually decelerates by shutting off the power

facts.text: Linde states that Linde Reverse Assist Radar reduces vehicle speed and can bring the vehicle to a complete stop.
facts.quote: It "reduces the vehicle's speed and can even bring it to a complete stop"

facts.text: Linde states that Linde's AI camera is optimized to recognize work and protective clothing.
facts.quote: Linde's AI camera is "optimized to recognize work and protective clothing"

facts.text: Validation methods, independent evaluations and field problems for Linde Reverse Assist Radar and Linde's AI camera were not found.
facts.quote: Validation methods, independent evaluations and field problems: not found.

facts.text: Simulation studies exist for forklifts and automated guided vehicles.
facts.quote: Simulation studies and commercial automatic deceleration or braking products exist for forklifts and automated guided vehicles
